ARQAAM ACADEMY

Services / Arqaam Academy

The training arm of Arqaam Capital.

Arqaam Academy has the region’s most rigorous institutional investment banking programme designed to develop technically excellent, execution-ready capital markets professionals from within the GCC, for the GCC.

Arqaam Analyst Programme

A centre of excellence for investment education.

Programme delivers:
Structured learning, practical application, and a clear talent pipeline through the Arqaam Analyst Programme.

 
To Apply Click Here
